## GGiftResult type

Result of `TemplateManager.getGGift` for a `<g-gift>` block.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type GGiftResult = {
    kind: `gift`;
    text: string;
};
```

## Remarks

`text` is the rendered gift card text; the getter throws when the block is missing (gifts always need card text).
